text: Aaj ke din bas itna yaad rakhiye ki har sthiti mein apna dhairya mat khoiye. Jagannath ji ki tarah sabhi ke liye prem aur samanta ka bhav rakhein.
Hanuman ji se preran lein: Bina kisi sandeh ke apna sabse behtar prayas karein. Natije ki chinta kiye bina apne kartavya par tika rehna hi sachi shakti hai.
ନିଜର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକୁ ସଚ୍ଚୋଟତାର ସହ କରନ୍ତୁ। ନମ୍ରତା ଓ ସେବା ମନୋଭାବ ହିଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ସଫଳତା ଆଣିଦେବ।
Focus your mind on pure intentions today. When your heart is light and kind, clarity unfolds effortlessly in every decision.
Choti mushkilon ko apni shanti mat cheenne dijiye. Apni aantarik urja par bharosa rakhiye aur muskurate hue aage badhiye.
Prem aur karuna har rishte ko aalokit karte hain. Aaj kisi ke chehre par ek choti si muskan laane ka prayas karein.
ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ଶାନ୍ତ ମନରେ ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ସଦାସର୍ବଦା ଉତ୍ତମ ଫଳ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିଥାଏ।
Rath Yatra ka sandesh hai ki mahaprabhu har bhakt ke paas swayam aate hain. Apne man mein shraddha aur samarpan ka bhav sajayein.
Hanuman Jayanti par sankalp lein ki kisi bhi chunauti ke aage jhukna nahi hai. Apni nigahon mein aatmavishwas ka roop rakhein.
Cultivate gratitude for small wins today. True harmony begins inside your heart before it reflects in the world.
